question: Who set the world record for the farthest distance swum in 48 hours (female) in a 25 m pool, covering an astonishing 149.02 km (92.59 miles) in just 2 days?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karolina Szczepaniak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Karolina Szczepaniak**, a remarkable long-distance swimmer from Poland, achieved the **world record for the farthest distance swum in 48 hours (female)** in a 25-meter pool.
 
• She covered an astonishing **149.02 km (92.59 miles)** in just two days, showcasing her exceptional endurance and swimming capabilities.
 
• This record-breaking feat demonstrates the **physical and mental strength** required to sustain such a performance over 48 hours.
 
• Her accomplishment has been recognized globally, placing her among the elite athletes in the field of long-distance swimming.
 
• This achievement emphasizes the importance of **training, discipline, and determination** in competitive sports.&
